notes: "To try HUANDENG from source you need Node 22.12 or later and pnpm through corepack. Clone the repository, install with the frozen lockfile, build the core package, and start the desktop app. Then open or create a project and try it on a deck you actually maintain; that is where the useful feedback comes from. If you use an agent, the Agent setup panel generates the connection for your client. Contributions of every size help: an issue describing where the workflow broke, a report of an agent mistake with the exact operation it produced, or work on one of the gaps from the previous slide. Before opening a pull request, run the type check, the unit tests and the formatting check. The repository is at github.com/JaytonKogeru/huandeng."
